text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
As the sun begins to set for the day
and the number of visitors increases,
the crew find themselves getting used to their work.
text_block_list.orig_text:
太陽が少し沈みはじめた頃、忙しさが増す中で
{0}たちは仕事に慣れ始めていた。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
So yeah. I asked that all the visitors try to help each other out as much
as possible. And if there's anyone's that's [[really]] in trouble,
they can send them to me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それでね、
できるだけ参拝する人たち同士で
助け合ってってお願いして、
本当に困った人がいたら、
教えてもらうようにしたんだ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Now we don't need to run around all over the place.
The problems just come directly to us!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それからはあちこちに行かなくてよくなったし、
困ってる人がずっと見つけやすくなったよ！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
So you took {0}'s advice and implemented it
on a wider scale. Impressive. You're always
on the ball when push comes to shove, aren't you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
彼のアドバイスを応用したのか。
さすがだね。
ヒヨリはここぞという時に、
ひらめきを発揮する。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. You think?
...Oh! Someone's calling out for me!
Lemme go see what's up!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えへへ、
そうかなぁ？
──
あっ！　
誰か呼んでる！　
ちょっと行ってくるねー！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
Some people never change, do they?
She really will do whatever it takes to help others.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まったく、
ヒヨリは相変わらずだな。
人を助けるためなら、
いつだって全力だ。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
That's what makes her so great.
Though I'm kind of scared to take my eyes off her sometimes.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そこがヒヨリちゃんのいいところだよね。
放っておけないところでもあるけど。

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
You and me both. We'll just have to keep looking out for her...
Hey, you two! We're on temple grounds here.
There'll be no fighting on my watch.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだね。
おかげであまり目を離せない……
おい、
そこのキミたち！　
ここは神殿だ。
こんなところでけんかはやめなさい。

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
They're not even interested, are they?
Sorry. I'll go and sort them out!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……二人とも興奮してるな。
まるで聞こえてない。
すまない、
ちょっと仲裁に行ってくる！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Take care! That's the two of them gone now.
It's funny how similar they can be, isn't it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
気をつけてねー！　
レイちゃんも行っちゃった……
放っておけないところ、
二人ともそっくりだよね。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Hm... I'd be lying if I said I wasn't worried about them,
but we should keep an eye out as well.
Who knows when another wish could materialize.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うーん……
二人も心配だけど、
わたしたちだけでも、
お客さんを見てたほうがいいよ。
また願いが出てくるかも知れないし。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Hey, Mr. Knight.
text_block_list.orig_text: あのね……騎士クン。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry.
We kind of got you all wrapped up in this.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ごめんね……
せっかくの大晦日なのに、
忙しくなっちゃって。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure you wanted to spend New Year's Eve
with Kokkoro and everyone else, didn't you?
choice_data_list: I'm happy to spend it with you three.
If anything, I want to thank you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
本当なら、
コッコロちゃんたちと
ゆっくり過ごせたんじゃないかなって……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Really? What a relief...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ホントに？　
よかったぁ～……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Oh, no! There's no need for that!
I'm... I'm more than happy that I can spend it with you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんな、
お礼なんていいよ！
わたしも……
騎士クンと一緒で、
うれしいから。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Th-that didn't sound weird, did it?
Urgh... I always get so nervous when we're alone.
text_block_list.orig_text:
い、今の、
変な意味に聞こえてないよね……？
うぅぅ……
二人っきりになると緊張しちゃうよぉ……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: I didn't realize he'd be this happy about it, though...
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも騎士クン、
こんなに喜んでくれてたんだ……

text_block_list.name: Woman's Voice
text_block_list.text: Eeeeeek!
text_block_list.orig_text: きゃあー！！

text_block_list.name: Man's Voice
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what's your deal?!
U-uwaaahhh!
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、
なんだおまえ！？　
う、
うわぁーっ！！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
That's our cue!
Let's get going, Mr. Knight!
text_block_list.orig_text:
人の声が！　
騎士クン。
行ってみよう！

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text: Ugh! Get away!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やだぁっ！　
こっち来ないでー！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Th-that's...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
あれって……！

text_block_list.name: Corporeal Wish
text_block_list.text: Someone... Please.. Teach me...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ダレカ……
オシエテ
クレ……！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Eeek! I-it's coming this way!
What should we do?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひうっ！
　
こ、
こっちに来る！　
ど、どうしよう……！

text_block_list.name: Corporeal Wish
text_block_list.text: Someone... Anyone... I'm begging you...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ダレカ……
ダレデモ
イイ、
ダレカァ……！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
It's going to bother the temple visitors at this rate!
We need to do something about it.
The two of us, together!
text_block_list.orig_text:
このままだと参拝に来た人たちが困っちゃう！
……ここは、
わたしと騎士クンで、
なんとかしなくちゃ！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
U-um!
What is it that you want to know?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
あのっ！　
何を教えてほしいの……？

text_block_list.name: Corporeal Wish
text_block_list.text:
I just... wanted to kiss... my girlfriend.
A nice, romantic kiss...
text_block_list.orig_text:
カノジョト……
キス、
シタカッタ……
ロマンチックナ、
キス……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Whaaaaaa?! K-kiss?!
U-uhhh.... I'm not too sure about that, myself.
text_block_list.orig_text:
えええええっ！？　
キ、キス！？
う、
うーん、
どーしたらできるんだろーねー？

text_block_list.name: Corporeal Wish
text_block_list.text:
Someone teach me....
Teach me... how to kiss...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ドウスレバキス、
デキル……
ダレカ！　
オシエテ……！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Waugh! This is bad!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あううぅ……
どうしよう〜！！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
If anything, I want someone to teach [[me]].
I'll never be able to purify this!
text_block_list.orig_text:
キスする方法なんて、
わたしが知りたいくらいなのに……
これじゃあ浄化なんて無理だよぉ〜！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Mr. Knight.
What should I do here?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねえ、
騎士クン……
どうしてあげたらいいかな……？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Ourselves...? W-wait! Wait just a minute!
Are you... Are you implying that we should kiss?!
Right here?! Right now?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わたしたちで……？　
そ、
そそそそ！　
それって！
もしかして
ここで
キ、
キスするの……！？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Me and you? Kiss?! No way!
I mean... I-it's a kiss, you know?
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士クンとわたしで！？　
そんなの無理だよぉ！
だって……
キ、
キス……
なんだよ……？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Urgh...
Hiyori! Rei!
Help!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うううぅ……
ヒヨリちゃーん！
レイちゃーん！　
どうしよう〜！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Yui!
text_block_list.orig_text: ユイちゃーん！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: Are the both of you okay?
text_block_list.orig_text: 二人とも大丈夫？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Hiyori?! Rei?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヒヨリちゃん！？　
レイちゃん！？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Yup! That's my name!
What's wrong? Does your tummy hurt?
Wanna take a little break?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうです！　
ヒヨリでっす！
どしたのユイちゃん？　
気分悪い？　
少し休む？

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
It's rare for Yui to be this distressed.
Just what sort of wish are we dealing with?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ユイがこんな風になるなんて……
一体どんな願いが相手なの？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Err... W-well, truth is...
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっと……
じ、
実はその……
あのね……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Mr. Knight, I...
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士クン。
わたし……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Nope! Nope, nope, nope!
Absolutely not!
text_block_list.orig_text:
無理無理無理っ！
　
わたしには無理だよぉ～！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Wow, she's really not digging it.
Does it want her to eat bugs or something?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ユイちゃんがここまで嫌がるなんて……
虫でも食べるの！？

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
We're dealing with a force we may not have anticipated.
Just what in the world was its wish?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
これはかなり厄介な願いに違いない。
コイツは何を願ったんだ……！？

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
Don't push yourself, Yui.
We can take your place if need be—
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ユイ。
無理しないでいいよ。
私たちにできることなら代わって──

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: L-let's not go that far...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
それは……！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
I still dunno what's going on, but I'm all ready!
To do, uh, something.
text_block_list.orig_text:
よく分かんないけど、
あたしも準備オッケーだよ！
えーっと、
何すればいいんだっけ？

text_block_list.name: Corporeal Wish
text_block_list.text: Someone... teach me...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
オシエテ……
ダレカ……！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Wait up, Hiyori!
Eeek?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヒヨリちゃんちょっと待って！
きゃっ！？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Owieeee...
text_block_list.orig_text: あいたたた……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Are you okay?
text_block_list.orig_text: 大丈夫？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine, yeah.
Thanks for helping, Mr. Knight...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん……
騎士クン、
かばってくれたの？
ありがとう……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Whaaaaa?!
text_block_list.orig_text: えええええっ！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what's going on?! Why's his face so close?!
Any closer and we'd practically be kissing!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なななな、
なんで！？　
騎士クンの顔が近いよー！
本当に、
キス、
しそうな距離……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
S-sorry about that!
I'll get away from you right away!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ご、
ごめんね騎士クン！？
すぐにどくから！

text_block_list.name: Corporeal Wish
text_block_list.text:
Woooooow!
This is it! This is the trick to kissing!
text_block_list.orig_text:
オオオオオ……！！　
コレナラ！　
キス、
デキル！！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Wh-what are you—
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええぇぇっ！？　
な、
何を言って……

text_block_list.name: Visitor
text_block_list.text:
Wew, look at them go.
Guess someone couldn't wait for the new year to roll around!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お、
なんだ？　
新年にもなってないのに熱々だな！

text_block_list.name: Visitor
text_block_list.text: Think they'll go all the way?
text_block_list.orig_text:
もしかして、
あのままキスしちゃうのかな？

text_block_list.name: Visitor
text_block_list.text: Brings back memories, doesn't it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
懐かしいな、
母さん。

text_block_list.name: Visitor
text_block_list.text: We were all lovey-dovey like that back in the day.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私たちの若い頃を思い出しますね、
あなた。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Y-you've got it all wrong!
That's not what's going on here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ち、違います！　
そんなつもりじゃないんです！

text_block_list.name: Corporeal Wish
text_block_list.text:
Kiss...
Kiss! Kiss! Kissssss!
text_block_list.orig_text:
キース……
キース！
　キース！！
　キース！！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: What's this about... kissing?
text_block_list.orig_text:
キス……
だと？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
A... kiss? Whaaaaaa?!
You're telling me the only way to purify
that wish is for the two of them to kiss?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
キ……
ス？　
えええええっ！？　
そ、それって……！
ユイちゃんと騎士くんがキスしないと、
浄化できないってこと！？

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: Th-this isn't a turn of events I was expecting...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ま、
まさかそんなこと……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
His face is so close...
Is this it...? Is this how it happens?
Can I... Can I finally...
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士クンの顔、
さっきより近づいてきてる気がする……
……このまましちゃうのかな、
キス……
今なら、
騎士クンと……

text_block_list.name: Corporeal Wish
text_block_list.text: Kiss! Kiss! Kiss!
text_block_list.orig_text: キース！

text_block_list.name: Visitors
text_block_list.text: Kiss! Kiss! Kiss!
text_block_list.orig_text:
キース！　
　キース！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Ki...

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Ki... Ki..! *wither*
text_block_list.orig_text:
キ、
キ……！　
きゅぅぅぅ……

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
Yui! Are you okay?!
Get a hold of yourself!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ユイっ！？　
大丈夫か！！　
しっかりして！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Yui!
She's out for the count.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ユイちゃん！！　
……気絶しちゃってる。

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
Take care of Yui.
We'll deal with that thing ourselves if it comes to it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
キミ、
ユイを頼む。
ヤツは最悪私たちでなんとかする！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
You realize the two of us'll have to kiss, don't you?!
But wait! Look!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それってレイさんとあたしがキスするの！？
あっ！　
ねえレイさん。
あれ見て！

text_block_list.name: Corporeal Wish
text_block_list.text:
I finally... understand!
Kissing wasn't what I wanted...
It was this!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヤット、
ワカッタ……！　
オレガモトメテタノハ、
キスジャナクテ、
コレダッタンダ……！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: Did its wish get granted?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひょっとして、
願いが成就したのか？

text_block_list.name: Corporeal Wish
text_block_list.text: Consider me fulfilled.
text_block_list.orig_text: ゴチソウサマデシタ……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: And puff it goes...
text_block_list.orig_text: ……消えちゃった。

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
That was enough to do the job?
Well, uh... I'm glad it went well, at least.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あれで満足だったのか？
まあ、
あれだ。
とにかく浄化できたならよしとしよう。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
For sure!
Good job, you two!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だねっ！　
二人ともお疲れ様ー！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Mmm...
Oh. Mr. Knight...
text_block_list.orig_text:
んん……
あ、
騎士クン……

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Yui. Glad to see you're okay.
You had me worried there.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ユイ……
無事でよかった。
心配したよ。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: What happened to the wish...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
願いは？　
どうなったの……？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
It disappeared not long after you collapsed.
Its last words were \"consider me fulfilled.\"
text_block_list.orig_text:
ユイちゃんが倒れた後で、
すぐに消えちゃった。
ゴチソウサマ、
って言いながら……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Ahh, right.
Urgh...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そっか……
うぅぅぅ……

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
Why the long face?
We were able to purify it in the end,
so there's no reason to be down.
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうしたんだユイ。
浄化は成功したんだ。
素直に喜んだほうがいい。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Yup, yup!
Good stuff all around!
No problemo!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうそう！　
やったねユイちゃん！
ぶいぶいっ！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Y-yeah...
Ahaha... N-no problemo...
text_block_list.orig_text:
う、うん……
あはは……
ぶ、
ぶいぶいっ……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Urgh...
I didn't even get to do anything in the end!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うぅぅ……
結局わたし、
なんにもできなかったよぉー！！
